item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will remain cool in the morning over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the monsoon moderating, the weather will be milder over the region during the day on Thursday. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Friday. It will become cool again over the region over the weekend. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Pabuk over the southern part of the South China Sea will move towards the vicinity of southern Vietnam in the next couple of days.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Rather cool with a few light rain patches in the morning. Sunny intervals in the afternoon.

R.H. range: 55 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low
